verdict.rationale: Workforce onboarding and offboarding tracking is a fair question for a compliance automation platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of HR-system sync, per-employee onboarding or offboarding checklists, training-completion tracking, or proof that leavers lost access. The nearby items are adjacent features that do not deliver this story: 'Onboarding Mode' is admin setup of the compliance program, access reviews are periodic reviews rather than offboarding checklists, and policy acknowledgment is a policy workflow.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access
